# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in revoke-probe or the revoke-node
OS-layer firewall, please email:

  security@revokenode.io

PGP key: TODO (will publish on revokenode.io/security)

Please do NOT open a public GitHub issue for security reports.

## What's in scope

- The probe scanner itself (this repo)
- The revoke-node OS-layer firewall (separate codebase)
- The revokenode.io web infrastructure

## Out of scope

- Issues in third-party AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Cline, Aider,
  Copilot, MCP server implementations) — please report those to the upstream
  vendor

## Response time

We aim to acknowledge within 48 hours and provide a disclosure timeline
within 5 business days.
